synopsis: In this episode of Sunrise Pure Bhojon Bilashi Season 2, host Somak Ghosh travels to the historic town of Serampore, a former Danish colony on the banks of the Hooghly River. He meets actress Parno Mittra, who shares stories of her early acting career, personal life, and love for cooking. Together, they play a guessing game and enjoy delicious local dishes prepared by Chef Prasanta Dawn, before receiving a mysterious clue about their next destination.

scenes.summary: Somak stands next to the red food truck and deciphers the clues, realizing that his destination is Serampore.
Title sequence of the show featuring aerial shots of Serampore's landmarks and the food truck driving through the town.
Somak arrives at St. Olav's Church and explains the history of Serampore as a former Danish colony and printing hub.
Somak walks around the streets asking locals for clues and meets an enthusiastic fan who takes a selfie with him.
Somak reaches a historic building where Parno Mittra teases him from the balcony before they warmly greet each other.
Somak and Parno sit outside Serampore College and discuss its history as one of the oldest colleges in India.
Chef Prasanta is introduced, and Parno challenges Somak to guess the first dish using clues, which is revealed to be Chanar Paturi.
Chef Prasanta prepares Chanar Paturi inside the food truck, wrapping the spiced cottage cheese in banana leaves.
Parno talks about starting her acting career at a very young age and moving to Mumbai due to school-related trauma.
Parno shares details about her early acting training, and they play a guessing game for the second dish, which Somak correctly identifies as Railway Mutton Curry.
Chef Prasanta prepares the Railway Mutton Curry inside the food truck kitchen.
Parno talks about her passion for cooking and mentions cooking for her bedridden mother who can no longer cook.
